shards.text: MUST run all five supply-chain gates (cargo-audit, cargo-deny, npm-audit, dependency-review, lockfile-integrity) before merging a pull request.
ALWAYS reject a dependency whose license or source is outside the cargo-deny al policy.
MUST NOT regress the WASM benchmark numbers recorded in BENCHMARK.md.
Always profile a hot path with the nanosecond scheduler before optimizing it.
MUST run the numerical regression suite on every change to a solver kernel.
Always assert the measured residual is be tolerance before reporting a system solved.
Use a Krylov method (Conjugate Gradient or BiCGSTAB) for symmetric-positive-definite systems that are not diagonally dominant.
NEVER rely on plain Jacobi iteration for a system that is not diagonally dominant.
